When I writing formalized solutions of olympiad geometry problems, I find that suprisingly I can't find a theorem in mathlib to directly prove that line[ℝ, A, B] ∥ line[ℝ, C, D] given that 2 • ∡ A B C = 2 • ∡ D C B. So, I add that (and some variation of it) in #43964, which is my first PR to mathlib.
Can anyone have a look at it?
